description:
Go-to-market surface: true one-page marketing site. Brand/design direction, approved copy, palette and typography live in docs/brand.md — that is the primary reference; build from it.

Positioning (unchanged): "The fingerprint is earned, not configured" — continuity of self across AI sessions; the upgrade story is protecting what you've already built, not a feature paywall.

## Visual direction superseded 2026-09-16

The original "Earthy & Type-Led" cream direction (cream #EDE5D8 / sea salt / ink / jade / clay / cornflower, Space Grotesk) is RETIRED. Founder call after seeing the two palettes side by side. Replaced by **Dark Instrument**: ground #0E1518, surface #141D21, sunk #111A1D, ink #E9EFEF, muted #94A4A9, faint #6D7E83, line #243237, accent #5FBFB2 — the accent is Jade lifted in lightness and saturation, so it is the same hue family rendered on a near-black ground. Typography resolved: Instrument Sans (display/UI), Newsreader (body serif), JetBrains Mono (data/labels), Noto Sans Hebrew (the mark only). docs/brand.md is updated and carries the retired direction under "Superseded" with the reasoning that still holds. tests/tailwind-config.test.ts asserts config and brand.md agree.

## Shipped 2026-09-16

- Design audit against t3.codes as reference: 11 findings, 3 critical. Root cause was never the palette — nothing on the page had a max-width (sections rendered 3425px wide), the headline was 48px/600/no-tracking, and every paragraph was set in the secondary tone.
- Container (max-w-1080) applied to every section; radial "well" background so a wide viewport frames the column.
- Hero collapsed to a single column, headline to clamp(44px,6.4vw,76px) at weight 600 / -0.035em. Sidebar cards deleted — they restated features 01-03 verbatim.
- Nav wordmark is English ZUG. Hebrew appears exactly twice (hero origin line, footer), set in Noto Sans Hebrew at ~1.35x the adjacent Latin, and WITHOUT niqqud — the shuruk dot read as dirt below ~20px and was the "looks like a mistake" complaint.
- Type scale raised to 17.5px/1.62 body throughout.
- Layout primitives extracted: Container, SectionHead, Callout, DataCard, ContextFunnel.
- Four demonstration sections replacing assertion-style feature copy:
  - HowItWorks — Observe/Record/Synthesize/Inject on a numbered rail, each step naming the real artifact it writes (observations.jsonl, reinforcements.jsonl, sessions/, PERSONA.md, PLAYBOOK.md, lessons.jsonl, ACTIVE.md).
  - ContextFunnel — three tiers (Accumulated / Synthesized / Injected) with real sizes from a live ~/.zug: 103KB observations + 280 session recaps, compressing to 34KB PERSONA + 20KB PLAYBOOK, of which only ACTIVE.md (1.5KB) is injected per session. This is how the clues-vs-retrievable mechanic is communicated.
  - WorkContext — "it knows the shape of what you work on": role/stack/repo-ownership/open threads, plus a first-thirty-seconds transcript comparison (cold agent greps 15 times; agent with the fingerprint names the owning service).
  - Superpower — without/with session ladder plus an SVG fan-out showing subagents inheriting the fingerprint.
  - Recaps — Zug recaps positioned against git history and the ticket queue as work evidence, with the real recap shape (Summary / Decisions / Next Steps / Observations).
- SignatureMoment kept as the one orchestrated motion moment, relocated into Synthesize (step 03) and re-triggered on IntersectionObserver instead of a 1200ms load timer, which previously played the reveal to an empty room.
- FeatureGrid removed from the page (component + tests retained) — all four one-liners are demonstrated by the sections above it.
- 131 tests green, tsc clean, verified in-browser.

## Open items resolved

- Typefaces: resolved (see above).
- Hero sidebar 3-card copy: resolved by deletion.

## Remaining on this ticket

Signup CTA remains a waitlist/email-capture placeholder; wiring to live Stripe Checkout stays split out and blocked on T-050. Everything else remaining is tracked on T-063.

Acceptance: a visitor can experience the full landing page — hero, the four demonstration sections, motion, responsive layout, brand execution — and submit the placeholder signup CTA. No live payment required.
title: Landing page + pseudonymous signup + pricing ($5/mo, $50/yr)
